assumptions: Explicit hypothetical FY2027 US-GAAP diluted EPS and P/E sensitivity, not consensus, a target, or an observed multiple. FY2027 is a 53-week year; $4.85 six-month GAAP diluted EPS is the reported anchor. Bear/base/bull annual EPS of $8.00/$10.00/$12.00 imply residual second-half EPS of $3.15/$5.15/$7.15 under a constant-share approximation. Q3 revenue guidance is $108bn +/-2%, 74% GAAP gross-margin guidance, approximately $9.2bn GAAP opex and 16%-18% FY tax-rate outlook; no Q4 guidance or forward diluted-share count is supplied. P/E stress assumptions 20x/24x/28x test earnings execution and multiple compression/expansion without empirical probability, fair-value claim, or historical-multiple claim.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
